jobs.name: B · 竹锋飒爽
jobs.summary: 切角短发 · 方斜短装 · 果断直接
jobs.detail: Personality decisive bold capable captain, short broad angular face, straight strong brows, alert squared almond eyes without eyeliner, short slightly flat nose, confident closed half grin, warm outdoors skin with a tiny single cheek scar. HAIR jet black short asymmetrical CUT-ANGLE bob: blunt diagonal forehead edge, one ear exposed and other side a single long cheek-length wedge, close nape, no ponytail/bun/braid/feather headpiece, one plain bronze rectangular clip. Palette bamboo green/ink charcoal/ivory/warm brown. Tailoring: a fitted bamboo-green sleeveless short cross-over jacket with wide CREAM diagonal lapel shaping a fuller bust, narrow brown waistband and one rectangular buckle; only one short square-cut shoulder cape resting on rear shoulder, with ONE big angular bamboo-leaf motif. Exactly two firm trapezoid hip panels over cropped tapered charcoal riding trousers, knee-to-ankle simple brown wraps and flat brown calf boots. Design language angular diagonals, compact rectangles and firm triangular stance; dynamic weight slightly forward, no oversized cape tails. Sleek sturdy arms, minimal plain bracers. Entire character should feel crisp and resolute, totally different from soft swallow feathers.

jobs.name: C · 杏风俏皮
jobs.summary: 粗侧辫 · 圆袖短摆 · 机灵活泼
jobs.detail: Personality playful mischievous sociable ADULT huntress with a broad round-oval face, short chin, one raised curved eyebrow, bright simple round-almond eyes and asymmetric toothy grin, a few freckles. Not a child, not a doll face. HAIR rich chestnut brown with a chunky SINGLE SIDE BRAID forming one curved rope shape over far shoulder, short swept-up forelock and large simple apricot cloth tie; no high ponytail, no double buns, no feather hairpiece. Palette warm APRICOT yellow/soft jade green/ivory/cocoa brown. Tailoring lightweight fitted apricot short wrap blouse with well-shaped fuller bust and rounded ivory neckline facing, rounded little puff sleeves ending above elbow; small sage-green rounded crescent cloud shoulder collar, only ONE large ivory wind curl. Waist a sage cloth band tied at side, TWO short broad tails; asymmetrical rounded petal hem panels over dark green practical knee-length riding shorts, simple calf wraps and low soft brown boots. Skin coverage appropriate opaque clothing; naturally feminine curves, not muscle plates. Graphic language circles, buoyant arcs and short rounded hems, lots of quiet solid apricot cloth. Pose cheeky hip shift, one knee softly bent, clear separated feet, cheerful expression, easy low-held bow and separate arrow. No many tiny bows/bells, no long trailing feather tails.

jobs.name: D · 月竹沉静
jobs.summary: 横刘海半笠 · 长襟窄袖 · 从容神秘
jobs.detail: Personality composed reserved contemplative mature ADULT archer, gently long rounded face with blunt chin, low level fine-but-graphic brows, calm half-lidded eyes with little black pupils, small straight nose and a restrained slight smile; no glamour winged eyeliner. HAIR straight ink-black SHOULDER LENGTH with a crisp horizontal blunt fringe, a single long jade hairpin, and a SMALL slanted half-moon shaped BAMBOO HAT at back upper head, face fully visible. No ponytail/braid/bun or swallow hair horns. Palette moon IVORY/deep teal/gray jade/warm bamboo, muted bronze accents. Tailoring elegant high diagonal Chinese collar and fitted ivory upper jacket shaped around fuller bust, one fitted narrow sleeve and opposite simple short sleeve/bracer; deep-teal modest waist cinch. Long clean open-front overcoat split into TWO broad vertical panels with one large simple bamboo-shadow silhouette on lower hem, charcoal close riding trousers and understated teal low-heel boots, both legs and boots distinct. One short translucent-looking color is NOT allowed; all cloth fully opaque. Graphic language tall rectangles, smooth crescent bow/hat and slow sparse vertical drape, while ANATOMICAL PROPORTIONS stay compact like reference, not taller than others. Gently balanced contrapposto with no squat. Quiet mysterious air, no large cloak wing, no skirt made of feather scales, no overdecorated talismans.
